column3: NASB supplies “chastisement” and “anymore”; the meaning is uncertain.
“Apart from what I see” is rendered “what I do not see”; NASB uses an older form.
“From with you” is rendered “on your terms”; the verse is difficult, and the meaning is uncertain.
“People of heart” is rendered “Men of understanding.”
“Would that” is rendered “ought to be”; the meaning of the first word is uncertain.
